In countries like Nigeria and Venezuela, these creators require dependable infrastructure to sell digital products without barriers. COREMERCH provides a solution with stack deployments that ensure sovereignty and autonomy. This guide focuses on using Supabase as the order database for your digital store, leveraging Stack 01 for rapid deployment and efficient operations, all while avoiding conventional payment processors.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

In today’s digital economy, reliance on conventional payment platforms can hinder your ability to succeed. Stack 01 provides a robust alternative by leveraging GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for hosting and backend management. This infrastructure is designed to ensure that you own your online store without the risk of account freezes or payment rejections. By establishing your store on this foundation, you gain the freedom to operate independently, enabling you to focus on your digital products and customer engagement without platform constraints.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, ensure you have the necessary tools and accounts. You will need a GitHub account for hosting, a Google account for setting up Apps Script, and an account with NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Additionally, prepare your product files and descriptions in advance. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint documentation, as it outlines the deployment process step-by-step. This preparation will streamline your setup and ensure your store is ready to go live quickly.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is crucial for operational efficiency. Start by integrating NOWPayments into your Apps Script to handle automatic payment processing. Ensure your products are loaded into your database, and configure your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This setup allows customers to receive their products immediately upon payment confirmation. Pay attention to testing your payment flow thoroughly on the mainnet before launching. This ensures a seamless experience for your customers and protects your revenue stream.
Sovereignty means you own your infrastructure, free from platform restrictions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up and tested, it’s time to go live. Announce your store through social media and other channels to drive traffic. Monitor your first transaction closely to ensure that the entire flow works as intended. Check that payments are processed correctly and that product delivery is instant. Any issues should be addressed immediately. This first transaction will be crucial for building trust with your customers and setting a strong foundation for future sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is operational, consider how to scale effectively. Utilize Supabase's capabilities to manage increased order volume by optimizing your database queries and ensuring fast data retrieval. Analyze customer feedback and sales data to refine your product offerings. Consider deploying additional products or features based on what resonates with your audience. This proactive approach will help you grow your customer base and revenue sustainably.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, leverage open-source tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. Stack 01 provides a straightforward deployment process, allowing you to set everything up in about 4 to 6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. This setup gives you full ownership of your digital store without the need for traditional payment platforms.
Automate payment processing with NOWPayments for a seamless experience.

It includes advanced features like Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase integration, all within a robust framework designed to maximize your operational efficiency. Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account for hosting. Set up a Google account for Apps Script access. Register with NOWPayments for crypto processing. Prepare your product files and descriptions for upload. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint documentation. Configure your payment and delivery pipeline using NOWPayments and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test your setup thoroughly on the mainnet. Announce your store launch on social media. Monitor your first transaction closely to ensure functionality. Analyze sales data for future scaling opportunities.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments, utilize GitHub Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for handling transactions. This no-cost setup allows you to manage everything without third-party dependence.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 leverages GitHub Pages and Apps Script for rapid deployment, taking 4 to 6 hours. Stack 02, on the other hand, utilizes Cloudflare Pages and Supabase, offering enhanced features and full deployment in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Both platforms provide reliable hosting solutions suitable for static sites and dynamic functionality through backend scripts.
What payment systems can I use with this infrastructure?
You can use NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low fee structure. This allows you to accept payments seamlessly without traditional banking restrictions.
How do I ensure my store is secure from payment fraud?
To secure your store from payment fraud, use NOWPayments' built-in security features and always test your payment flows thoroughly. Regularly monitor transactions for any unusual activity.
